description: Execution engine that binds Mission Graph → Scheduler → Agent Runtime → Validation.

pipeline.name: Planning
pipeline.action: Decompose mission into DAG, detect parallelism

pipeline.name: Graph Scheduling
pipeline.action: Order tasks by priority+dependencies, form parallel groups

pipeline.name: OpenCode Dispatch
pipeline.action: Dispatch task to OpenCode agent via subagent_task or subagent_direct

pipeline.name: Execution
pipeline.action: Agent executes task with specified permissions and timeout

pipeline.name: Validation
pipeline.action: Validate agent output against mission criteria

pipeline.name: Mission Complete
pipeline.action: Mark mission completed, archive results, update history

execution_modes.subagent_task: Launch agent as async task, wait for completion, collect result
execution_modes.subagent_direct: Launch agent synchronously for immediate work, stream results
execution_modes.parallel_broadcast: Launch multiple agents simultaneously on independent tasks
